card: Clears Taproot signatures and MuSig2 nonces and partial signatures when joining PSBTs in PartiallySignedTransaction::AddInput. Because joinpsbts constructs a new transaction, pre-existing signatures are invalidated, but stale Taproot signatures were previously retained, causing SignTaproot to skip signing and leaving joined P2TR PSBTs unable to be signed or finalized without manual edits. The PR adds missing field clears for v0 PSBTs and includes functional test coverage verifying that joined Taproot PSBTs can be completed.
changed_since_previous: The code and test logic are unchanged across patch versions; the update is an administrative rebase.
evidence: PR description: 'a bech32m (P2TR) input: taproot_key_path_sig is still there after the join, and walletprocesspsbt / finalizepsbt return complete: false... the only way out is editing the PSBT by hand.'
rpc_psbt.py functional test reproduces the failure on master and verifies that joined Taproot inputs can be successfully signed and completed after the fix.
problem: When combining PSBTs with joinpsbts, previous signatures are invalidated because the transaction inputs and outputs change. For Taproot inputs, stale key-path signatures were left in place; because SignTaproot skips signing when a key-path signature is already present, walletprocesspsbt and finalizepsbt fail to complete the joined transaction, requiring manual PSBT editing to recover.

risk.why: A mistake could discard valid input fields or fail to properly clear stale signatures during joinpsbts, affecting users combining partially signed transactions.

summary: Clears Taproot and MuSig2 signatures and nonces when joining PSBTs via PartiallySignedTransaction::AddInput. Previously, adding inputs to a joined v0 PSBT dropped legacy and Segwit v0 signatures but left Taproot key-path signatures, script-path signatures, and MuSig2 fields intact. Clearing these fields ensures stale signatures are stripped so subsequent signing steps can generate valid signatures for the new transaction.
